shopkeeper_orange.png:
A single cartoon shopkeeper character for a cute game set in a cat ninja tower, full body, facing left.

The character: a plump ginger orange tabby cat merchant, standing upright on two legs, wearing a short
indigo shop coat with the sleeves rolled up and a beige apron tied at the waist, a small coin pouch on
the belt, round friendly face with a wide sly salesman grin and one eye squinted shut, whiskers,
a thick striped tail curling up behind.

Pose: one paw raised and open in a welcoming "come in, have a look" gesture, the other paw resting on
its hip, leaning slightly forward, cheerful and a little pushy.
It stands on the ground with its feet at the very bottom edge of the picture - do not draw it floating.
Fill the frame vertically. Readable at small size (it will be shown about 150 pixels wide):
bold silhouette, strong shapes, no fine detail that disappears when shrunk.
Draw everything SOLID and OPAQUE - flat filled colour with soft shading. Nothing transparent or see-through.
Nothing else in the picture: no counter, no shelves, no goods, no ground line, no shadow, no scenery,
no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no border.
Style: thick black outlines, flat colors with subtle soft gradients, cute cartoon look, not photorealistic.
Background must be a solid pure green (#00FF00), completely flat, for chroma keying.
Output 768x1024 PNG. Save the image as shopkeeper_orange.png in the current directory and report the path.
